local({

  first <- if_else(grepl("[0-9]", answer), sub("^[^0-9]*([0-9]+([.,'][0-9]+)?).*$", "\\1", answer), NA_character_)
  first <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[,']", ".", first)))
  never <- grepl("yok|hi[çc]|h[ıi]c|almad|alamad|almd|mama kul|^o ay$", answer, ignore.case = TRUE)
  spelled <- grepl("bir|[iİ]ki|[üÜ]ç|dört|beş|^on | on |yarı|evet", answer, ignore.case = TRUE)
  date <- grepl("(19|20)[0-9]{2}", answer)
  case_when(
    date ~ NA_character_,
    !is.na(first) & first > 0 ~ "TRUE",
    !is.na(first) & first == 0 ~ "FALSE",
    never ~ "FALSE",
    spelled ~ "TRUE",
    .default = NA_character_
  )
})
